title: Wogonin Alleviates Kidney Tubular Epithelial Injury in Diabetic Nephropathy by Inhibiting PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB Signaling Pathways.
authors: Lei, Lei; Zhao, Jing; Liu, Xue-Qi; Chen, Juan; Qi, Xiang-Ming; Xia, Ling-Ling; Wu, Yong-Gui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物Wogonin通过抑制PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB信号通路缓解糖尿病肾病肾小管上皮损伤，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Kidney tubular epithelial injury is one of the key factors in the progression of diabetic nephropathy (DN). Wogonin is a kind of flavonoid, which has many pharmacological effects, such as anti-inflammation, anti-oxidation and anti-fibrosis. However, the effect of wogonin in renal tubular epithelial cells during DN is still unknown. MATERIALS AND METHODS: STZ-induced diabetic mice were given doses of wogonin (10, 20, and 40 mg/kg) by intragastric administration for 16 weeks. The metabolic indexes from blood and urine and pathological damage of renal tubules in mice were evaluated. Human tubular epithelial cells (HK-2) were cultured in high glucose (HG) condition containing wogonin (2muM, 4muM, 8muM) for 24 h. Tubular epithelial cell inflammation and autophagic dysfunction both in vivo and in vitro were assessed by Western blot, qRT-PCR, IHC, and IF analyses. RESULTS: The treatment of wogonin attenuated urinary albumin and histopathological damage in tubulointerstitium of diabetic mice. We also found that wogonin down-regulated the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines and autophagic dysfunction in vivo and in vitro. Molecular docking and Cellular Thermal Shift Assay (CETSA) results revealed that mechanistically phosphoinositide 3-kinase (PI3K) was the target of wogonin. We then found that inhibiting PI3K eliminated the protective effect of wogonin. Wogonin regulated autophagy and inflammation via targeting PI3K, the important connection point of PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. CONCLUSION: Our study is the first to demonstrate the novel role of wogonin in mitigating tubulointerstitial fibrosis and renal tubular cell injury via regulating PI3K/Akt/NF-kappaB signaling pathway-mediated autophagy and inflammation. Wogonin might be a latent remedial drug against tubular epithelial injury in DN by targeting PI3K.
abstract_zh: 引言：肾小管上皮损伤是糖尿病肾病（DN）进展的关键因素之一。汉黄芩素（wogonin）是一种黄酮类化合物，具有抗炎、抗氧化和抗纤维化等多种药理作用。然而，汉黄芩素在DN肾小管上皮细胞中的作用尚不清楚。材料与方法：通过灌胃给予STZ诱导的糖尿病小鼠汉黄芩素（10、20和40 mg/kg），持续16周。评估小鼠血液和尿液中的代谢指标及肾小管病理损伤。人肾小管上皮细胞（HK-2）在高糖（HG）条件下培养，并加入汉黄芩素（2μM、4μM、8μM）处理24小时。通过Western blot、qRT-PCR、IHC和IF分析评估体内外肾小管上皮细胞炎症和自噬功能障碍。结果：汉黄芩素治疗减轻了糖尿病小鼠的尿白蛋白和肾小管间质组织病理损伤。我们还发现，汉黄芩素在体内外下调了促炎细胞因子的表达和自噬功能障碍。分子对接和细胞热位移分析（CETSA）结果表明，机制上磷脂酰肌醇3-激酶（PI3K）是汉黄芩素的靶点。随后我们发现，抑制PI3K消除了汉黄芩素的保护作用。汉黄芩素通过靶向PI3K（PI3K/Akt/NF-κB信号通路的重要连接点）调节自噬和炎症。结论：我们的研究首次证明汉黄芩素通过调节PI3K/Akt/NF-κB信号通路介导的自噬和炎症，在减轻肾小管间质纤维化和肾小管细胞损伤中发挥新作用。汉黄芩素可能是一种通过靶向PI3K治疗DN肾小管上皮损伤的潜在治疗药物。
